description: A Perl script for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device, involving network device discovery via UDP broadcast, FTP control commands, and firmware upload procedures.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with ADAM2 devices, including environment variable retrieval and reboot functionality.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a reboot command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
